name: Erika Wilkins
source: Brandon’s little sister who used to try to embarrass him by running around farting and flashing her panties at him and his friends at a young age. Their parents had a divorce, splitting the two up for about 5 years ago. She is now seen more as a smart, bookworm kind of girl who isn’t very social and rather avoids interactions that she feels isn’t worth the time, only opening up more around her friend Miki and Brandon the most.
